sections.title: Test Coverage Analysis
sections.content: **Zero test coverage exists.** No test files (`.test.js`, `.spec.js`, etc.) are present anywhere in the project. All testable logic lives in `.claude/helpers/`.

sections.title: Testable modules and their exports
sections.content:
| Module | Exported functions | Lines |
|--------|-------------------|-------|
| `router.js` | `routeTask`, `AGENT_CAPABILITIES`, `TASK_PATTERNS` | 67 |
| `memory.js` | `commands` (`get`, `set`, `delete`, `clear`, `keys`) | 83 |
| `session.js` | `commands` (`start`, `restore`, `end`, `status`, `update`, `get`, `metric`) | 136 |
| `intelligence.cjs` | `init`, `getContext`, `recordEdit`, `feedback`, `consolidate`, `stats` | 1032 |
| `hook-handler.cjs` | no exports (side-effectful entrypoint) | 287 |
| `statusline.cjs` | no exports (side-effectful entrypoint) | 547 |

---

sections.title: Gap 1 — `router.js`: `routeTask`
Gap 2 — `memory.js`: `commands`
Gap 3 — `session.js`: `commands`
Gap 4 — `intelligence.cjs`: Pure helper functions (not exported — need refactor or inline tests)
Gap 5 — `hook-handler.cjs`: Integration / E2E
Gap 6 — `statusline.cjs`: Unit-testable pure functions
Priority order for implementation
sections.content:
| Priority | Module | Reason |
|----------|--------|--------|
| 1 | `intelligence.cjs` | Most complex — PageRank, dedup, graph building; bugs here are hardest to debug |
| 2 | `session.js` | Session corruption causes cascade failures across all hooks |
| 3 | `router.js` | Pure function, easiest to test, high usage via every hook |
| 4 | `memory.js` | Pure function, straightforward file I/O |
| 5 | `hook-handler.cjs` | Integration tests, needs child-process harness |
| 6 | `statusline.cjs` | UI rendering; lowest risk, needs export refactor first |

**Most critical actionable refactor:** extract the private helpers in `intelligence.cjs` (`tokenize`, `trigrams`, `jaccardSimilarity`, `computePageRank`, `deduplicateById`, `deduplicateByContent`, `fingerprintContent`, `buildEdges`) into a separate `intelligence-utils.js` module so they can be unit-tested independently of file system side effects.
